content.short: MetaMask is the world's most popular self-custodial crypto wallet and Web3 gateway used by 30M+ people, fully compatible with Mantle Network.
content.description: MetaMask is the leading self-custodial Ethereum-compatible wallet, used by over 30 million people worldwide across its browser extension and mobile app. As the de facto standard for Web3 wallets, MetaMask provides users with a secure key vault, connection management for dApps, token management, and token swaps powered by the MetaMask Aggregator. Mantle Network is fully compatible with MetaMask  users simply add Mantle as a custom network to access the full Mantle DeFi ecosystem seamlessly.
content.meta: MetaMask is the world's most popular self-custodial wallet with full Mantle Network compatibility. Discover MetaMask on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
